description: The Cohansey tea-fight by Lucy Ellen Guernsey is a historical short story written in the late 19th century. Framed as a family reminiscence, it centers on colonial New Jersey and a local protest against British tea, culminating in a dramatic “tea-fight” on Cohansey Creek.
